name: Livegrep Open-Source Code Search
free_limit: BSD-style open-source regex code search for large source repositories; self-hosted indexing backend and web UI with no software license or per-search fee.
watch_out: Requires Bazel build or your own container deployment, separate indexing/search processes, and self-managed CPU, RAM, storage and repository access; hosting costs are not included. This is not a managed hosted search tier.
